loreEntries.title: The Proving Isle
loreEntries.text: For generations, the Order of Proving Wardens has maintained this wind-swept headland as a compact training ground. Five landmarks ring the coast: the stone Courtyard, the Ember Forge Terrace, the pine-shaded Whispering Grove, the crumbled Watchtower Ruins, and the Beacon Cliff overlooking the open sea.

loreEntries.title: Concealed Crafting & Field Combinations
loreEntries.text: Artisans on the terrace teach two distinct arts. At the Craft & Forge bench, pairing two primary materials under a general category creates an item whose exact form is revealed once forged. Out on the road, dragging or combining compatible items in your Inventory hones blades, coats steel with resin, or brews quick salves.

loreEntries.title: Formations, Stances & Arcana
loreEntries.text: Skirmishes test more than raw strength. Frontline foes shield backline archers until the frontline falls, though ranged weapons and indirect spells can strike past them. Use Brace, Feint, consumables, companions, and Grimoire spells to turn tough odds in your favor.

loreEntries.title: The First Warden's Oath
loreEntries.text: Old ledgers say the isle's first Warden hid her bronze signet beneath a cedar root in Whispering Grove so that observant recruits who take time to search their surroundings would uncover it.
